notes.title: Beta 0.3.6 Music Changes
notes.notes:
Most of the game music has been changed to help influencers keep monetized when publishing videos about the game.
 Fixed character rotation bug.

notes.notes: Fixed a game-breaking bug that causes the game to freeze when you check the todo list paper while using Russian language.
